Class UpgradeItem

java.lang.Object
Item_Classes.Item
Item_Classes.UpgradeItem
public class UpgradeItem extends Item
Represents a permanent stat upgrade item (e.g., Stewshine, Mikan Mochi, Kurosawa Matcha). Directly modifies character stats upon application.

  • Constructor Details

    • UpgradeItem

      public UpgradeItem(String name, int price, String targetStat, float upgradeAmt, NPChar condition)
      Constructs an UpgradeItem with a specified name, purchase price, target stat, and upgrade magnitude.
      Parameters:
      name - the descriptive name of the item
      price - the monetary gold cost of the item
      targetStat - the attribute stat targeted by this upgrade
      upgradeAmt - the magnitude of stat adjustment applied by this item
      condition - the NPC that must be rescued to unlock this item, or null if unconditional

    • use

      public boolean use(PlayableChar player)
      Overrides the base use execution. Stat upgrades take effect automatically upon purchase via applyUpgrade rather than manual inventory usage.
      Overrides:
      use in class Item
      Parameters:
      player - the playable character interacting with the item
      Returns:
      false always, as upgrades are applied immediately upon store purchase
